Subject: Selwyn Electric - Referral Required

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the submission on Selwyn Electric. I've reviewed the information and have everything I need to move forward.

However, this risk requires referral to senior underwriting due to the contractor class of business. Before I submit it internally, could you please provide the following details:

- What types of electrical contracting work do they perform (residential, commercial, industrial)?
- What is their typical project size range?
- Do they perform any high-hazard work (high voltage, underground, etc.)?
- What percentage of work is subcontracted out?

Once I have these answers, I'll escalate for review and get back to you promptly.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
